mapper.select: SELECT game_id AS "gameId", step_id AS "stepId", sequence_id AS "sequenceId", step_order AS "stepOrder", operation_type_id AS "operationTypeId", target_selector_type_id AS "targetSelectorTypeId", condition_formula_key AS "conditionFormulaKey", change_revision AS "changeRevision", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM public.effect_steps WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND step_id = #{stepId}
mapper.update: INSERT INTO public.effect_steps (game_id, step_id, sequence_id, step_order, operation_type_id, target_selector_type_id, condition_formula_key, change_revision, updated_at) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{stepId}, #{sequenceId}, #{stepOrder}, #{operationTypeId}, #{targetSelectorTypeId}, #{conditionFormulaKey}, #{changeRevision}, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (game_id, step_id) DO UPDATE SET sequence_id = EXCLUDED.sequence_id, step_order = EXCLUDED.step_order, operation_type_id = EXCLUDED.operation_type_id, target_selector_type_id = EXCLUDED.target_selector_type_id, condition_formula_key = EXCLUDED.condition_formula_key, change_revision = EXCLUDED.change_revision, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT game_id AS "gameId", step_id AS "stepId", sequence_id AS "sequenceId", step_order AS "stepOrder", operation_type_id AS "operationTypeId", target_selector_type_id AS "targetSelectorTypeId", condition_formula_key AS "conditionFormulaKey", change_revision AS "changeRevision", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM public.effect_steps WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND change_revision > #{previousRevision} AND change_revision <= #{publishRevision} ORDER BY change_revision, step_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.effect_steps_log ( game_id, version_id, change_revision, step_id, sequence_id, step_order, operation_type_id, target_selector_type_id, condition_formula_key ) SELECT game_id, #{versionId}, change_revision, step_id, sequence_id, step_order, operation_type_id, target_selector_type_id, condition_formula_key FROM public.effect_steps WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND change_revision > #{previousRevision} AND change_revision <= #{publishRevision} ON CONFLICT (game_id, step_id, version_id) DO UPDATE SET change_revision = EXCLUDED.change_revision, sequence_id = EXCLUDED.sequence_id, step_order = EXCLUDED.step_order, operation_type_id = EXCLUDED.operation_type_id, target_selector_type_id = EXCLUDED.target_selector_type_id, condition_formula_key = EXCLUDED.condition_formula_key
